title: Meta 首次推出 Muse AI 代理。消费者会信任它吗？
content: Meta 的新个人 AI 代理 Muse 希望访问用户的电子邮件、日历、支付、健康服务等，这是该公司最大的消费者 AI 赌注，也是人们是否仍然信任 Meta 处理其数据的重大考验。

original_content: Meta's new personal AI agent Muse wants access to users' email, calendars, payments, health services, and more — making the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet a major test of whether people still trust Meta with their data.
